_README: Poses the director asked for while making a video, because no pose in the cast file expressed what the narration described.
Generated once, then reused by every later video.
Safe to delete: anything still wanted is simply asked for again.
Editing casts/<style>.json wins over anything in here.

krabs.hand_envelope: one claw holding out a paper pay envelope toward the viewer, other claw at side, grudging expression

sponge.take_envelope: both hands reaching to take the envelope, huge open grin, eyes crinkled with joy
